channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Noodles & Company: $7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7
item.guid: Noodles & Company-$7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7-2026-11-12
item.description: Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page. (Through November 15, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Luna Grill: Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal with Each Adult Entree, Dine-In
item.guid: Luna Grill-Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal -2026-11-12
item.description: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, Club Luna Rewards members (free app account) get one free kids meal per adult entree, up to two per check, for children 10 and under, dine-in only with the child present. Show the offer in the Luna Grill app when ordering. All locations except San Diego Airport; not combinable with other offers. (SoCal & Texas only) (Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays)

item.title: The Great Greek Mediterranean Grill: Buy One, Get One Free Gyros, Pitas or Appetizers with Code BOGO, Online Orders
item.guid: The Great Greek Mediterranean Grill-Buy One, Get One Free Gyros, Pitas or Ap-2026-11-12
item.description: Limited time at Michigan locations: add two qualifying items from the same category on the chain's own ordering site (for example a Chicken Great Greek Gyro, Feta-Filled Kebab Gyro or Falafel Pita, $10.99 to $12.99 each) and enter promo code BOGO at checkout to get one free. One BOGO per order; categories cannot be mixed; no account needed. Seen on the Byron Center, Ann Arbor, West Bloomfield, Troy and Allen Park ordering pages. (Michigan only only) (Limited time)

item.title: Harris Teeter: Traditional Turkey Dinner for 6-8, $69.99
item.description: Harris Teeter's weekly ad features a fully cooked Traditional Turkey Dinner serving 6 to 8, including turkey, stuffing, mashed potatoes, gravy and more, for $69.99. (Mid-Atlantic & Southeast only) (Through Nov 17, 2026)

item.title: Tijuana Flats: Throwback Thursdaze: Burrito or Bowl + Chips + Drink for $8.99
item.guid: Tijuana Flats-Throwback Thursdaze: Burrito or Bowl + C-2026-11-12
item.description: Every Thursday at participating locations: a Tijuana Burrito or burrito bowl plus chips and a drink for $8.99 in-store, online, or in the app - no third-party delivery; pricing varies slightly by location. (FL & Southeast only) (Thursdays only)

item.title: Corner Bakery Cafe: Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Half Salad, Soup, Sandwich or Pasta Plus a Side
item.guid: Corner Bakery Cafe-Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Hal-2026-11-12
item.description: Limited time at select cafes: any Choose Two combo (two of a half salad, half soup, half sandwich or half pasta) plus a side for $8.99, all day. Enter code 1551 at online checkout or mention it in the cafe; no account needed, not valid on third-party delivery. The offer is set cafe by cafe: it shows for Fair Oaks in Fairfax, Bethesda, both DC cafes and cafes in Illinois, Texas, Georgia, Pennsylvania and Tennessee, so pick your cafe on Corner Bakery's offers page to confirm before you go. (Select cafes: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX, GA, PA & TN only) (Limited time)

item.title: Yoshinoya: $5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code CE41FLDF
item.guid: Yoshinoya-$5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code -2026-11-12
item.description: Standing coupon on Yoshinoya's own coupons page: add two regular rice bowls (chicken, beef or veggie) in-store, online or in the app and apply code CE41FLDF at checkout for $5 off; no account needed. Not valid on ribeye, salmon or limited-time items; participating locations. The same page lists $5 off two large bowls (code CRSA6MCE), $5 off two combo bowls (C6Z88J4A) and 20% off $20 (C9M7P979), 25% off $25 (C3FBHN3D) or 30% off $30 (up to $10 off). (California only only) (Ongoing)

item.guid: Rubio's Coastal Grill-$7+ Meal Menu: Fish & Chips for $7.9-2026-11-12

item.guid: Giant Food-$5.99 Whole Rotisserie Chicken (Save up -2026-11-12
item.description: Giant Food's weekly ad offers a whole rotisserie chicken for $5.99 after a clipped digital coupon, free loyalty card required. (DC, MD, VA & DE only) (This week)

item.title: Panera Bread: Buy $50 in Gift Cards, Get a Free $10 Bonus Card
item.guid: Panera Bread-Buy $50 in Gift Cards, Get a Free $10 Bo-2026-11-12
item.description: Buy $50 or more in Panera gift cards in-cafe, in the app or online and receive a free $10 bonus card redeemable in January, no code needed. (Through December 31, 2026)

item.title: Mezeh Mediterranean Grill: Free Delivery on Every Order Through the End of 2026
item.guid: Mezeh Mediterranean Grill-Free Delivery on Every Order Through the-2026-11-12
item.description: Through the end of 2026, delivery orders placed on mezeh.com or in the Mezeh app carry no delivery fee, for anyone, no code or account needed. Build-your-own bowls, wraps and family packs all qualify. Stated on Mezeh's own homepage. (VA, MD, DC, PA, NC, SC, GA, FL & TX only) (Through December 31, 2026)

item.title: Playa Bowls: Free 16 oz Cold Brew with a Chocolate Coconut Joy or Chocolate Covered Strawberry Bowl for Playa Rewards Members
item.guid: Playa Bowls-Free 16 oz Cold Brew with a Chocolate Co-2026-11-12
item.description: Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 13: Playa Rewards members (free account) get a free 16 oz Playola or Sweet Cream Cold Brew with the purchase of a Chocolate Coconut Joy Bowl or Chocolate Covered Strawberry Bowl, in the shop, on playabowls.com or in the app for pickup. One redemption per member, modifiers extra, not valid on third-party delivery; participating shops while supplies last. Stated on Playa Bowls' own current-promotions page. (East Coast only) (November 9 to 13, 2026)

item.title: Moe's Southwest Grill: Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with Any Purchase for Moe Rewards Members
item.guid: Moe's Southwest Grill-Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with -2026-11-12
item.description: Through Sunday, November 22: Moe Rewards members (free account) get one Grilled Burrito Dipper with the returning shredded-beef Birria free with any purchase, in the app, online or in the restaurant. Single use; the fine print says the offer goes to select members, so check the Rewards tab in the app before ordering. Not valid with dipper pans, other offers or third-party delivery; participating locations. Stated on moes.com. (35 states (Southeast, Northeast & Midwest) only) (Through November 22, 2026)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-11-12
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-11-12
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Waba Grill: Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with Each Full-Price Entree
item.guid: Waba Grill-Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini-2026-11-12
item.description: Every day: one free kids Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with the purchase of any full-price entree, weekdays after 4 PM and all day Saturday and Sunday, at all WaBa Grill locations. No account or coupon needed. Stated in WaBa Grill's own press release and on its homepage. (CA, AZ, NV & TX only) (Weekdays after 4 PM, all day weekends)
